note.zh: 五点半的渔港，雾还没散，船都在原地；退潮以后，湿沙把天空又还给了一遍。同一片海，隔几个钟头就换一副面孔。
note.en: At half past five the mist had not lifted and the boats had not moved. After the tide went out, the wet sand gave the sky back. The same sea, a few hours apart, wearing a different face.

desc.zh: 五点半，雾还没散，船都在原地。
desc.en: Half past five, the mist had not lifted, and the boats had not moved.

desc.zh: 湿沙把天空又还给了一遍。
desc.en: The wet sand gave the sky back once more.
